notes: v2.9.70 UI: The first-screen header now shows a compact live Kiwoom account summary directly beside the version: account number, cash deposit, order-available cash, holding count, total evaluation, and evaluation P/L. Hovering the summary shows exact values plus withdrawable cash, D+2 estimated deposit, estimated assets, unsettled cash, and up to eight holding names/quantities/returns. Account data refreshes asynchronously every 15 seconds and after trading activity so it does not block the trading UI. Watermelon, concrete, and auto-trading rules remain unchanged from v2.9.69.
